items.Label: Opposing counsel

items.Label: Scope / budget change

items.Label: Court / Filing

items.Label: Scope / budget change
items.Summary: The tribunal approved a document production phase lasting about four months. A revised budget estimate for this phase will be sent next week.

items.Label: Scope / budget change
items.Summary: The client requests a second-opinion review of a freedom-to-operate analysis focused on robotics patents. They require a scope and cost estimate for this work to be completed within one month.

items.Label: Invoice / Billing
items.Summary: The client requests an estimate of unbilled work in progress for all Kite Surgical matters through December 31. The estimate is due by December 20 for year-end close purposes.

items.Label: Scope / budget change
items.Summary: The opposing party has reopened negotiation points affecting timing and budget. The firm needs to revisit the budget and prepare for extended negotiations.

items.Label: Fee / rate change

items.Label: Scope / budget change
items.Summary: The client requests adding the Delaware entity to the scope of work for an additional $12k. Approval is needed to update the matter scope accordingly.

items.Label: Fee / rate change
items.Summary: The firm will change invoicing currency for all Brightline matters from sterling to US dollars starting next billing period. They request confirmation if invoices should be sent to a different address.

items.Label: Administrative
items.Summary: The sender requests confirmation of current 2026 hourly rates for timekeepers on Matter 1123. No changes to rates are being requested, only verification.

items.Label: Fee / rate change

items.Label: Court / Filing

items.Label: Scope / budget change
items.Summary: General Counsel instructs to extend the contract review to include 2019 and 2020 supplier contracts. The review is needed before the March meeting with the same criteria as before.

items.Label: Scope / budget change
items.Summary: The email informs about a substantial increase in monitoring work and associated monthly costs for the Halberd chapter 11 matter. It requests client input on whether to narrow the monitoring scope.

items.Label: Fee / rate change
items.Summary: The firm informs the client of a staffing change on the Kessler arbitration with a higher billing rate. Client input is requested regarding staffing preferences.

items.Label: Fee / rate change

items.Label: Fee / rate change

items.Label: Scope / budget change

items.Label: Scope / budget change

items.Label: Scope / budget change

items.Label: Administrative
